title: An Adaptive Fast Algorithm for Periodic Coulomb Lattice Sums in Arbitrary Unit Cells
summary: We present a fast algorithm for evaluating conditionally convergent Coulomb lattice sums, governed by the Laplace equation with periodic boundary conditions on arbitrary unit cells (oblique in 2D, triclinic in 3D) and arbitrary particle distributions. The algorithm extends the dual-space multilevel kernel-splitting (DMK) framework to this context.
